div.head: Ger 2.1
div.ab: [2.1] He sceal snotorlice smeagean ⁊ georne ðurhsmugan ealle ða ðing, ðe hlaforde magan to ræde.
He sceal snotorlice smeagean 7 geor|ne ðurhsmugan ealle ða ðing ðe hlaforde magan to ræde .
He sceal snotorlice smeagean and georne ðurhsmugan ealle ða ðing ðe hlaforde magan to ræde.
Er muss klüglich bedenken und eifrig im Geiste durchgehen alle die Dinge, die dem Gutsherrn zum Vortheil [sein] können.
He must wisely consider and eagerly go through in his mind all the things that can [be] of advantage to the lord.
He must wisely consider and eagerly think through all the things which may be of help to his lord.
He is to wisely consider and assiduously reflect upon all those things that might be of help to his lord.
div.note: ‘smeagean ⁊ … ðurhsmugan’ is an alliterating pair; the infinitive ‘sein’ is understood (ellipsis).
